build_arrayviz_html_rendering: build HTML rendering of a numpy array with arrayviz using render_array_data_to_html with column, row, and slider axes
create_balanced_array_truncation: create balanced truncation sizes for a large numpy array shape using infer_balanced_truncation with maximum size and cutoff constraints
infer_colormap_bounds: infer vmin and vmax colormap bounds from a numpy array with optional around_zero and trim_outliers settings
infer_row_column_layout: infer ordered row and column axis assignments for array visualization layout using infer_rows_and_columns
create_value_colored_textbox: create a value-colored textbox rendering with colored background from a colormap and hover value display
